# Susan Albright — Account Liaison, The Joint Commission

- **Relationship:** external — Riverbend's liaison at **The Joint Commission**, the accrediting
  body whose survey confers CMS deemed status.
- **What's active:** she is the point of contact for the **Plan of Correction** owed after the
  **June 2026 survey** findings; she confirms acceptance of the POC and any follow-up survey.
- **Cadence:** formal correspondence only; all communications go through Quality
  ([Ellen Vasquez](ellen-vasquez.md)) and are reviewed by Compliance
  ([Nathan Cole](nathan-cole.md)).

## Notes
- Treat all contact as on-the-record and regulatory — never send informally; drafts route
  through Ellen and Nathan first.
